## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      8 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 6 may 2026 - 9 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Dustin Mallory_, 7 oct 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be amazing until they replaced their previous intuitive user interface with this AI Slop. After 10 seconds of you can tell that, that is clearly what this is. Absolutely no thought put into the usability of the UI whatsoever. Or if there was, it was whatever ChatGPT thought would be most usable. It's unusable now in its current state. I guess I'll be switching to another app."
            2. _Thorsten Mootz_, 30 ago 2026, 1/5: "Neues Update ist ganz schlimm und benutzerunfreundlich. If it's not broken, don't fix it..."
            3. _Harun_, 4 ago 2026, 1/5: "I have been using this app for more than 10 years now. In the beginning it was the perfect app. But it is too laggy/buggy now. And also there is too much downtime lately. Other than that still an ok app to track macro's. UPDATE: THE LATEST UPDATE ON ANDROID SUCKS UNFORTUNATELY. I CAN'T DELETE A WHOLE MEAL AT ONCE ANYMORY, ALSO DON'T HAVE AN OVERVIEW OF MY MEALS LIKE ON THE WEB VERSION. I'M A PREMIUM USER AND I SERIOUSLY CONSIDER CANCELING MY SUBSCRIPTION! HOPE THIS WILL BE FIXED ASAP!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
